entry.title: New: BILL005(24) (Honolulu) — FILE
entry.content:
RELATING TO NOISE CONTROL

Prohibits the playing; using; operating; or permitting to be played, used, or operated, a machine or device for producing or reproducing sound on any public property or space if the sound generated is audible at a distance of 30 feet from the machine or device. Exempts from prohibition certain stationary equipment subject to regulation by the State Department of Health and, as permitted by law, certain warning devices. Clarifies that specified exempt activities are exempt whether or not they are conducted on city, State, or federal property. Preserves restrictions on noise in city parks under existing ordinance, and any permit for the playing of music in a city park must conform to existing requirements.

Latest action: Filed pursuant to ROH SEC 1-2.4 which sets a two-year filing period on pending bills.
